title: fix(console): the Marketplace package page names a suggested binding's permission set by its label
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg6v19uPsX6gX42G8tGcvvzb)_

Fixes #34094

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：应用市场包详情页安装后的「建议授权」横幅，其提示、状态行，以及授权 / 忽略 / 撤销 / 重新考虑的提示消息，改为用权限集的标签（如「CRM user」）称呼，不再用机器名（如 `crm_user`）。与 Studio → 访问里同一横幅共用一个取标签的函数。
- **为什么改**：违反「给人看的地方用标签，机器名至多作次要文字」的约定；Studio 那一处已在 #34088 修好，这是同一组件的另一个挂载点。
- **风险与回滚**：只改显示层，不改写入、接口或契约。横幅挂载时多一次只读请求（按包列出权限集，与 Studio 访问栏同一读取）；读取失败或无标签时退回机器名，不报错。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**：`MarketplacePackagePage.tsx`（`PackageSuggestedBindings`，三处挂载改用它）、`components/suggestedSetLabel.ts`（共享函数与读取 hook）、`StudioDesignSurface.tsx`（两行，改用共享函数）。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui/packages/app-shell exec vitest run --root ../.. packages/app-shell/src/console/marketplace/__tests__/MarketplacePackagePage.installedSuggestions-33158.test.tsx`，预期 10/10 通过，其中 objectstack#34094 一组 5 条。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/components/suggestedSetLabel.ts` (new): `suggestedSetLabel(s, sets)` names a suggested binding's set by the label of the matching set, falling back to `permission_set_name` when the set is not held or its label is empty. `usePackagePermissionSets(packageId)` reads the package's own sets once per mount with `client.list('permission', { packageId })`, the read the Studio Access rail makes; a refused or failed read yields no sets, so every set is named by its machine name, with no error.
- `MarketplacePackagePage.tsx`: the inline `suggestionStrings` object, which interpolated `s.permission_set_name`, becomes a `PackageSuggestedBindings` component that draws the prompt, the state lines and the Grant / Dismiss / Revoke / Reopen toasts through `suggestedSetLabel`. All three mounts on the page (installed-package panel, post-install result, served-deploy panel) use it.
- `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`: the Access pillar's local `suggestedSetLabel` now delegates to the shared helper over the rail's `perms`, so the two mounts cannot name one set two ways.
- The suggestion payload is unchanged. The label is read on the page, not carried by the API; `packages/**` is untouched.

## Tests

- A new `describe` in the existing harness `MarketplacePackagePage.installedSuggestions-33158.test.tsx`: the prompt names the label and the read is `list('permission', { packageId })`; Grant then Revoke, where both toasts and the accepted line name the label; Dismiss, where the toast names the label; CONTROL, a set with an empty label is named by its machine name; CONTROL, a refused read of the sets names the machine name and shows no error toast.
- Ablation leg A: `suggestedSetLabel` was changed to return the machine name, applied with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `d286df1b` to `d6744dfb`). Result: 7 failed and 24 passed across the Marketplace pin file and the two Studio suggestion pin files (3 Marketplace and 4 Studio label pins red, CONTROLs green). After restore the blob is back to `d286df1b`, which equals HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` is empty.
- Ablation leg B: the Marketplace mount's `set` was changed to `s.permission_set_name` (blob `cf3e4e55` to `8d97b1d0`). Result: 3 failed and 7 passed (the three label pins). After restore the blob is back to `cf3e4e55`, which equals HEAD.
- The tests import the page and the helper from source by relative path, so no `dist/` is involved and no rebuild was needed for either leg.

## Acceptance notes

- The card asks where the label is read from: the page holds no permission-set list of its own, so it reads the package's sets with the same scoped metadata read as the Studio Access rail. The suggestion row carries only `permission_set_name`; nothing here asks for the payload to carry the label.
- The Revoke toast that the next card on this banner concerns is drawn in `SuggestedBindingsPanel.tsx`, in `act()` on the dismiss/revoke branch (`toast.success(action === 'revoke' ? strings.revokedToast(s) : strings.dismissedToast(s))`). The Marketplace pin in this PR sees it fire. That card's fix is not part of this PR.
- Local test scope was narrowed and is declared here: the Marketplace `__tests__` directory, `SuggestedBindingsPanel.test.tsx` and three Studio Access suites (66 files, 647 tests) ran locally, along with the package `type-check` (both `tsc` passes). The whole `@object-ui/app-shell` suite (2331 files) was stopped unfinished after 40 minutes on the shared lock, so it is NOT MEASURED locally and left to `Test UI` in CI.

## Verification

All readings below are on head `0cef8f75a6` (branch merged with `origin/main` `cdb327fdf0`).

The Marketplace `__tests__` directory, `SuggestedBindingsPanel.test.tsx`, and the Studio suites `accessSuggestionsReadOnly-33158`, `accessWording-34795` and `accessGuard`, run with the shared verify lock: `Test Files 66 passed (66)`, `Tests 647 passed (647)`, `VERDICT command-exit 0`. The pin file alone, run verbose: `Tests 10 passed (10)`.

</details>

<details><summary>Package type-check: green</summary>

`pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` ran both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` and exited 0. This was the first half of a `&&` chain whose test half then started.

</details>

37 families exited 0. `pnpm check:type-check-debt` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET), because the verify lock was held by this branch's own app-shell suite run. Re-run under the lock, it exited 0 (`check-type-check-coverage --re-measure: OK — 0 raw tsc error(s) total`). The `--ran` reconciliation shows 38 derived and 38 run. It reads the type-check-debt family as NOT-MEASURED because the record carries both exits.

`overlap-check`: `VERDICT clean exit 0` against `origin/main` and 0 open PR heads.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation: both legs red, both restored</summary>

Leg A (shared helper returns the machine name): 7 failed and 24 passed. Leg B (Marketplace mount passes the machine name): 3 failed and 7 passed. After each restore the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty. Details are under Tests.

</details>

Not measured locally: the whole `@object-ui/app-shell` suite, which was declared to `Test UI`, and the repo-wide `pnpm lint`, which CI owns. Dogfood: n/a, because the title has no `!` and there is no `(narrowing)` arm.
